title: Penthouse Magazine May 1990 Eichmann Secret Confession Sumo Wrestling
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos of the front and back covers for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Penthouse Magazine, May 1990. The International Magazine for Men. Cover price $4.50.

Features:
- Exclusive: Eichmann's Secret Confession
- Big Shots: the bizarre world of sumo wrestling
- Green Rage: fighting for our planet
- 'Markers': exploring the incongruous anatomy of power
- How to make peace in the Middle East
- Meet Your Meat: is eating beef immoral and dangerous?
